identity.objective: Design and preregister a synthetic benchmark that tests whether explicit FLOW_D representation adds held-out compositional-transfer and counterfactual value over matched same-information generic alternatives.

context_refs: FLOW_D accepted as first-class derived dynamical object
assumptions: Primitive #11 is not under test in RGR-05B.
Elemental labels are quarantined from the benchmark.
Same-information comparison is required for any claim of Flow-specific computational advantage.
unknowns: Whether explicit FLOW_D inductive structure improves compositional transfer.
Whether generic same-information models are sufficient.
Whether return/completion requires distinct representational support.

acceptance_conditions: F_G and F_F receive identical raw dynamic information.
Strong counterfactual family preserves topology and full edge-attribute multiset.
Carrier and node relabeling invariance are explicit.
Task A delivery and Task B return are separately scored.
Elemental and human data remain quarantined.
No materialization, training, runtime, schema, migration, or deployment occurs.
falsification_conditions: FLOW_D model receives privileged target information.
Generic comparator is denied raw information available to FLOW_D model.
Counterfactual pairs differ in undeclared shortcuts.
Elemental labels enter the generator or target.
Task A success is allowed to stand in for return/completion.
The benchmark design silently authorizes execution.
stop_conditions: A fair same-information comparator cannot be defined.
Counterfactual families cannot be generated with exact declared invariants.
Runtime or production mutation becomes necessary.

guard.authorized_core_snapshot: Benchmark constitution/design only; no materialization or execution authority.

execution_note: RGR-05B designs the benchmark only. Materialization, model training, benchmark execution, MAIA integration, member data, schema/migration, and deployment remain unauthorized.
